# Nitric Boost Ultra

> Nitric Boost Ultra is a Nitric Oxide & Male Performance Support Powder. Nitric Boost Ultra is a plant-powered dietary supplement in powder form, built to support nitric oxide production in the body. Because nitric oxide helps blood vessels relax and widen, the formula is aimed at supporting healthy circulation, physical stamina and male sexual performance. It is a drinkable powder rather than a capsule, typically mixed into water as part of a daily routine. The formula leans on botanicals and nutrients commonly used in the circulation and performance category, and it is marketed as a natural lifestyle supplement rather than a medication.
